record_hint: Use the MCP tools circuit_record_decision, circuit_record_impression and circuit_record_vision_review (or `python3 plugins/circuit/scripts/circuit_launcher.py record decision|impression|vision-review --json <file>`). Impressions need at least 400 characters and 3 sentences: what you noticed, what works, what worries you, how a maker or user would read it, and what to do next.
